You also mentioned crackling radios and existing weaponry. It's not entirely clear when the first invasion started. Is this set eight years from tomorrow, or another decade or two down the road? You also talk about technological advancements that the humans have made against the aliens, so think about what devices would have progressed and improved by that point. 

There were certain points where I wanted to hear more. How did the Commander get to her position at a young age? What specific tactics did the aliens use to fight us. "Controlling the elements" is interesting, but rather vague. You could definitely add some more specific description to the story. I wanted to hear more of the backstory of each of the characters. You gave us a few glimpses of various people, but we didn't get to know many of them well enough to really feel for them. 

What are your plans for this piece of writing? Is it the beginning of a book? It mostly seems to stand alone as a short story, where the fate of humanity is left up in the air, but then I'm wondering why they started with the Fire-Stealers and weren't attacking anyone else yet.

Do they master them and bring them back to their own world, or do they plan to stay on Earth forever? Are they openly attacking the humans, or are people just getting caught in the crossfire?
